references.text: Continuation of the prohibition against creeping things that move on the ground, with clarification that they are an abomination and make one unclean.
The reason for the prohibition: The people of Israel shall be holy because the Lord is holy, and they must not defile themselves with creeping things.
Repeats the prohibition against all winged creeping things—they are unclean and must not be eaten.
Earlier in the same chapter, winged creeping things that walk on four feet are mentioned, along with which ones are abominations.
List of specific creeping things that crawl on the ground and make one unclean.
Ezekiel describes abominations and creeping things depicted in the temple, showing the seriousness of profaning what is holy.
